description: Pilot a transforming war mech across Sector 09 in a 5-chapter Story Campaign with radio comms, convoy escort, relay capture, artillery sabotage, and a two-phase boss showdown — plus Endless Skirmish.
story: In Sector 09 — The Glass Reach, Warden Vex and the Crimson Directorate have dropped an armored mech legion to strip the ancient Helios fusion relays dry. Guided by Commander Kora and your chassis AI Vanguard-OS, fight across five desert operations, pick permanent field refits between chapters, and bring down Vex's towering dreadnought SOLARIS-0.
controls: W A S D or Arrow keys — Move war mech or drive 6-wheel combat car
Mouse + Left Click — Aim and fire active weapon
Right Click (hold) — Raise frontal energy Brace Shield
T — Transform between War Mech and 6-wheel Combat Car
G H J K L — Switch between 5 weapon styles (Vanguard, Bastion, Sunlance, Railbreaker, Craterfall)
Shift + A / D — Thruster side-roll dodge
X / Z — Switch between Siege Mode and Strider Mode
Q — Cycle target lock between enemy mechs
4 — Deploy Support Squad (2 hover drones + 3 armored cars)
Esc — Pause, switch Story/Endless mode, graphics preset, and audio settings
howToPlay: Choose Story Campaign (5 scripted desert chapters with saved progress) or Endless Skirmish from the Command Launch screen.
Follow live radio comms from Commander Kora and Vanguard-OS plus glowing 3D objective waypoints across the dunes.
Press T anytime to transform into a 6-wheel armored combat car to snatch Relay Cores, escort ATLAS-6, or dodge red artillery rings.
Between Story chapters, pick permanent tactical field refits (Overclock Rails, Composite Plate, Drone Uplink, Drive Servos, Missile Capacitors, or Pierce Cores).
Survive Warden Vex's Phase II Solar Overdrive in Chapter 5 to secure Sector 09 and log your Rank and Score on start.ng.
features: 5-Chapter Story Campaign ('The Glass Reach'): Recon & Core Salvage, Helios Relay Capture, ATLAS-6 Convoy Escort, Artillery Pylon Sabotage, and the 2-Phase SOLARIS-0 Boss Finale
Diegetic non-blocking radio comms with custom SVG pilot portraits and synthesized codec audio
Between-chapter permanent Tactical Refit choices that dynamically upgrade your mech across the campaign
Seamless transformation between twin-minigun War Mech and 6-wheel armored combat car
5 distinct weapon styles, homing missile salvos, Brace Shield, Support Squad, and deployable Missile Pods
Classic Endless Skirmish mode with auto-detected Eco GPU preset, start.ng pilot card, global leaderboard, and X score sharing
walkthrough: Chapter 1 (First Contact): Clear the 5 Crimson scouts, then morph into Car Mode (T) to sweep up all 3 emerald Relay Core beacons fast.
Chapter 2 (Signal Fire): Hold inside each glowing Helios Relay ring with Brace Shield (RMB) raised, and deploy Support Squad (4) when Breachers drop.
Chapter 3 (Iron Convoy): Stay within 24m of ATLAS-6 for Escort Boost and intercept Crimson ambushers ahead of the hauler.
Chapter 4 (Scorched Earth): Watch for crimson ground impact rings—use Shift+A/D or Car Mode (T) to dodge while burning Pylons down with Railbreaker (K) or Craterfall (L).
Chapter 5 (Sunbreaker): Use desert mesas as cover against SOLARIS-0's plasma fans; when Vex hits 50% HP and triggers Solar Overdrive, unleash your refilled missile rack (F) and Support Squad (4)!
